rv.q: All of that will swirl in your head as you watch two fine performances within an unstintingly disturbing piece of dramatic writing.
Under Spencer Huffman's direction, Lindsay and Wojcik tear through Harrower's story with excoriating honesty.
The New Theatre Project’s grimly honest environmental production succeeds in pulling us into that anguished moment of utter aloneness, to memorable effect.
This is a gripping, unsettling, and explosive production, presented by The New Theatre Project, that goes beyond the simple shock value to something that penetrates our very soul.
